title.zh: 日本GMO互联网集团遭网络攻击，债券利差扩大至174个基点
title.en: 日本GMO互联网集团遭网络攻击，债券利差扩大至174个基点

current_state.zh: A cyberattack on a listed subsidiary of Japan's GMO Internet Group widened the spread on its 2031 yen bonds to about 174 basis points from 122 before the unauthorized-access disclosure, as investors weighed potential earnings impact.
current_state.en: A cyberattack on a listed subsidiary of Japan's GMO Internet Group widened the spread on its 2031 yen bonds to about 174 basis points from 122 before the unauthorized-access disclosure, as investors weighed potential earnings impact.
